note: Hand-curated classification for the funds in the SimLife ticker directory. Wikipedia's S&P 500 table supplies sectors for individual stocks; ETFs are not on that list, so they are classified here. breadth is the field the Class-tab checks read: BROAD = spread across sectors; TILTED = diversified but deliberately leaning one way; SECTOR = one sector only; SINGLE_ASSET = one thing. Review breadth before relying on it for an assignment - it is a judgment call, not a fact.

VTI.name: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF
VTI.what: Essentially the whole U.S. stock market, large and small.

SCHX.name: Schwab U.S. Large-Cap ETF
SCHX.what: Large U.S. companies across every sector.

SCHA.name: Schwab U.S. Small-Cap ETF
SCHA.what: Smaller U.S. companies across every sector.

DIA.name: SPDR Dow Jones Industrial ETF
DIA.what: The 30 companies in the Dow. Spread across sectors, but only 30 of them.

QQQ.name: Invesco QQQ Nasdaq-100 ETF
QQQ.what: The 100 largest non-financial Nasdaq companies - heavily weighted toward technology.

SCHD.name: Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF
SCHD.what: U.S. companies selected for paying steady dividends.

VIG.name: Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF
VIG.what: U.S. companies with a record of raising their dividend.

VYM.name: Vanguard High Dividend Yield ETF
VYM.what: U.S. companies with above-average dividend payments.

VTV.name: Vanguard Value ETF
VTV.what: U.S. companies priced low relative to their earnings - a value tilt.

VUG.name: Vanguard Growth ETF
VUG.what: U.S. companies expected to grow quickly - a growth tilt.

SCHF.name: Schwab International Equity ETF
SCHF.what: Large companies in developed countries outside the U.S.

VEA.name: Vanguard Developed Markets ETF
VEA.what: Companies in developed countries outside the U.S.

VXUS.name: Vanguard Total International Stock ETF
VXUS.what: Companies outside the U.S., developed and emerging together.

BND.name: Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF
BND.what: A broad mix of U.S. bonds - lending money rather than owning companies.

AGG.name: iShares Core U.S. Bond ETF
AGG.what: A broad mix of U.S. bonds.

TLT.name: iShares 20+ Year Treasury ETF
TLT.what: Only long-term U.S. government bonds - one specific bet on interest rates.

VNQ.name: Vanguard Real Estate ETF
VNQ.what: U.S. property companies only - one sector.

GLD.name: SPDR Gold Shares
GLD.what: Gold. One metal, no companies at all.

XLF.name: Financial Select Sector SPDR
XLF.what: Banks, insurers and financial companies only.

XLE.name: Energy Select Sector SPDR
XLE.what: Oil, gas and energy companies only.

XLY.name: Consumer Discretionary SPDR
XLY.what: Companies selling things people buy when they have spare money.

XLU.name: Utilities Select Sector SPDR
XLU.what: Electricity, water and gas providers only.
